title: The Best Budget Flagships of 2026: iPhone SE 4 vs. Google Pixel 10a
subtitle: A comprehensive comparison of the two most anticipated mid-range smartphones of the year.

seo.description: Deciding between the iPhone SE 4 and Google Pixel 10a? Our detailed 2026 comparison covers design, AI performance, camera quality, and value for money.
